inline-edit.$description: InlineEdit's component tokens. Each one is an optional override: set the CSS variable (--inline-edit-<name>) on the page, a container or one InlineEdit, and every InlineEdit inside follows. Unset, it uses the shared token it references here; tools/test/foundation.mjs checks that bundle.css uses exactly these defaults. The field and the button's height and padding use Input's tokens.

text.$description: The text in the button (4.5:1 on the page and on the hover background).

placeholder.$description: The placeholder when the text is empty (4.5:1 on the page).

icon.$description: The pencil, on hover and focus (3:1).

bg-hover.$description: The button's background on hover (surface-muted, so the muted placeholder keeps 4.5:1 on it).

error.$description: The error message under the field (4.5:1).

gap.$description: Space between the field and its error message (4px).
